# Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage — facts

## Structure and components

- [statement] MongoDB's covered-query requirements say a single index must contain every query field, fields needed internally for sharding, and every returned field; on mongos, the index must contain the shard key. A general compound-index guide also notes that _id must be indexed or excluded from the projection. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-optimization/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://github.com/OneUptime/blog/blob/master/posts/2026-01-30-mongodb-compound-index-strategies/README.md, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/76295889/mongodb-index-need-to-include-id-for-it-to-cover-if-projecting-id

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB's hashed-index manual says hashed indexes cannot cover a query. Its server test shows that find({_id: true}, {_id: 0}) against a collection sharded by {_id: "hashed"} still has totalDocsExamined: 1, so the hashed shard-key value is not returned from the index alone. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js, https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js
- [statement] With a single-field hashed shard key, equality matches can target one shard; hashing preserves distribution for monotonically changing values but removes original-value range locality, so a range predicate cannot use the hashed index and may broadcast to multiple shards. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-04) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/create.md, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/configure-sharding-to-maximize-the-performance-of-shards
- [statement] Inference for compound hashed shard keys: MongoDB defines the compound form as an index with one hashed key and other ordinary ordered keys, while its index-type manual says hashed indexes cannot cover queries. The compound hashed index should therefore be treated as non-covering even when ordinary fields match the query and projection. The cited server test directly checks only a single-field hashed shard key, not this compound case. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/create.md, https://www.percona.com/blog/refining-shard-keys-in-mongodb-4-4-and-above/, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A compound hashed index hashes one field only and stores its other fields with ascending or descending order; the hashed field can be combined with ordinary fields before or after it. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/create.md · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/sharding-with-zones-based-on-compound-shard-keys-on-mongodb-4-4/, https://www.percona.com/blog/refining-shard-keys-in-mongodb-4-4-and-above/
- [statement] A non-hashed prefix in a compound hashed shard key can define zone ranges while the hashed field distributes values more evenly; this combination does not make the compound hashed index cover queries. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/sharding-with-zones-based-on-compound-shard-keys-on-mongodb-4-4/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/
